categories.main_business_segments: The Company operates primarily in two segments: gas storage and transportation, and intelligent manufacturing. The gas storage and transportation segment includes products such as LNG and CNG cylinders for vehicles, seamless steel cylinders, composite cylinders, ISO tank containers, cryogenic tanks, and gas station equipment. The intelligent manufacturing segment focuses on ground conveyance and assembly systems, suspension chain air conveying systems, robotic integration applications, stamping lines, and non-standard automation machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Company utilizes advanced pressure vessel design and manufacturing technologies, holding multiple design and manufacturing qualifications for pressure vessels. It produces over 800 types of cylinders including carbon fiber full-winding composite cylinders and plastic liner composite cylinders. The intelligent manufacturing segment integrates industrial automation, digitalization, networking, and intelligent manufacturing equipment, supported by ERP-based systems and digital empowerment platforms. The Company emphasizes R&D in hydrogen energy storage, Type III and IV cylinders, and intelligent production lines with remote monitoring and numerical control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major automobile manufacturers, industrial gas companies, and sectors such as chemical, medical, food processing, aerospace, and energy. The Company serves both domestic and international markets, with products accepted by seven of the world's top eight influential gas companies. The intelligent manufacturing segment targets the home appliances industry and industrial automation sectors, providing customized equipment and solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Company operates primarily in China with extensive domestic coverage through over 30 distribution offices nationwide. It also has overseas sales offices in the United States, Singapore, South Korea, India, and Australia. Overseas assets account for a small portion of total assets (2.72%). The Company leverages its overseas platforms to enhance logistics and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing gas storage and transportation equipment and intelligent manufacturing equipment. It integrates upstream raw materials like steel and forgings and serves downstream industries that apply these products. It also provides system integration and after-sales services, positioning itself as a comprehensive equipment manufacturer and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening technological self-reliance, enhancing R&D capabilities especially in hydrogen energy storage and Type IV cylinders, and promoting intelligent manufacturing and digital factory development. The Company focuses on innovation ecosystems, talent cultivation, and collaborative industry-academia-research efforts. It aims to expand market applications, improve product competitiveness, and accelerate industrialization and batching processes of new products.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of gas storage and transportation equipment and intelligent manufacturing equipment. The Company also earns income from technical consulting, installation, maintenance services, and leasing activities. Investment income and government subsidies contribute to non-operating income. The Company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Company is positioned as a leading manufacturer and service provider in the global energy gas storage and transportation equipment industry and a leading intelligent manufacturing solutions provider in China. It competes with other industrial gas equipment manufacturers and automation equipment providers, leveraging its scale, brand, technology, and comprehensive sales network. The Company faces intensified competition domestically and internationally, especially in hydrogen energy and industrial automation sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Company achieved operating income of approximately RMB1.649 billion, a 17.32% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB7.48 million. Total assets grew by 9.75% to RMB3.087 billion, and total liabilities increased by 16.77% to RMB1.674 billion. The Company maintains a stable capital structure with a gearing ratio of 54.25%. R&D expenses accounted for 4.19% of operating income, reflecting sustained investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Company emphasizes its scale and brand reputation, with over 20 years of industry presence and a well-known Tianhai brand. It offers a broad product portfolio with advanced technology qualifications and the ability to produce diverse pressure vessels meeting multiple international standards. Its integrated LNG/CNG system solutions and intelligent manufacturing capabilities provide differentiated, high-quality, and cost-effective products. The Company’s strong sales network and after-sales service enhance customer stickiness and market reach, while continuous innovation and digital transformation improve product quality and profitability.
